name: skill-companion-app
description: Skill-backed app: a Claude skill (or plugin) is the front door and the chat is the Claude app itself. A served HTML board plus a Python backend are its companion, started and stopped by the skill; data lives as JSON files in a user-owned folder outside the plugin install. Modelled on the social-engagement skill. No deployment: the plugin is the delivery.

_skill_companion._comment: Descriptive convention only (docs/stack-profiles.md, Skill-backed apps): host, delivery, companion and data_folder are NOT schema keys and no phase reads them. The unit that first reads them promotes them to real keys together with their schema entries and tests.

lifecycle.start: on demand, when the skill opens the board
lifecycle.stop: when the skill ends the round or the user asks to stop

data_folder.location: user-owned folder outside the plugin install (a plugin update replaces its own folder)
data_folder.contents: JSON files only; no external service

stack._comment: Versions are security-relevant MINIMUMS, not exact pins - resolve and install the latest version satisfying each range when scaffolding.
stack._comment_backend: Empty on purpose, as in chat-first-json: adopt scores a profile by the dependency names it declares here.

folder_structure..claude-plugin/: Plugin manifest (plugin.json); present when delivery is 'plugin'
folder_structure.skills/: The skill(s): skills/<name>/SKILL.md is the front door and starts/stops the companion
folder_structure.backend/: Python backend (backend/server.py serves the board and the JSON API, GET /api/health)
folder_structure.board/: The served board (HTML, CSS, vanilla JS) composed from the design kit
folder_structure.tests/: pytest unit tests for the backend and the skill scripts
folder_structure.e2e/: Playwright specs run against the served board (*.spec.ts)
folder_structure..dev-data/: Throw-away JSON data for development and tests (git-ignored); real data lives in the data folder
folder_structure.pyproject.toml: uv project file: pytest and ruff as dev dependencies, so 'uv run pytest' works in a fresh checkout
folder_structure.package.json: Dev tooling only (@playwright/test); the app itself is not a node project
folder_structure.playwright.config.ts: Playwright config: baseURL http://127.0.0.1:3911, webServer = the dev_server command; reuseExistingServer true is safe because 3911 only ever hosts the throw-away dev server, never the real companion on 3901

notes: Phase behaviour (recorded by campaign e2e-run-findings unit E2; see docs/stack-profiles.md): Build scaffolds the folder_structure above, not a node project. Test runs pytest then Playwright against the dev_server block. Preview and Browser Verify start only the dev_server block (the same backend the skill starts in real use, with a throw-away data dir). Deploy: there is no deploy step (deploy: null, deploy_target none); the plugin is installed, not deployed. The companion binds 3901 in real use; the dev_server block (preview, Browser Verify, Playwright) uses 3911 with a throw-away --data-dir, so a development run can never attach to the user's running companion and its real data. Playwright may reuse the server the Test phase already started on 3911 (reuseExistingServer true). backend/server.py must accept --host, --port and --data-dir, use --data-dir before <APP_NAME>_HOME and the default folder, and refuse to start rather than fall back silently when --data-dir is unusable. Harden the loopback API: bind 127.0.0.1; check the Host header; on state-changing routes check the Origin is same-origin and require application/json or a per-session token; no permissive CORS; keep a pidfile or idle timeout and handle port-in-use. The host is 127.0.0.1 everywhere so Node's localhost-to-::1 resolution cannot cause a false failure. The skill-companion facts (host, delivery, companion, data_folder) sit under the comment key _skill_companion: no schema key and no phase reads them yet.
